title: TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. translated_title: TOAST：面向自回归视觉-语言-动作模型的随机机器人动作分词方法
translated_abstract: 自回归视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action）模型通常将连续的机器人动作表示为离散的 token 序列，从而能够使用标准的下一个 token 预测目标进行动作预测。FAST 通过将包含多种时间频率的动作紧凑地编码为相对较少的 token，显著改进了这种表示方式。然而，尽管这种压缩减少了自回归预测所需的动作 token 数量，但它并不一定能在有限演示数据下提高策略学习的效率。特别是，FAST 通常为每个量化的动作序列分配单一确定性的分词方式，尽管实际上可以有多个 token 序列表示并解码为相同的机器人运动。我们研究了利用这种表示冗余是否能够改进策略学习。在本文中，我们提出了 TOAST（TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling，基于随机采样的动作序列分词），一种随机动作分词方法……
tldr: 提出TOAST随机动作分词方法，通过随机采样为同一机器人运动生成不同的token序列来利用FAST确定性分词所忽略的表示冗余，从而提升自回归视觉-语言-动作模型在有限演示数据下的策略学习效果。
en_tdlr: TOAST proposes stochastic robot action tokenization that exploits representational redundancy—assigning randomly sampled token sequences to the same quantized action instead of FAST's deterministic single tokenization—to improve policy learning efficiency in autoregressive vision-language-action models from limited demonstrations.
